eligibility: Require the genuine completed C/CZD package-v3 native outer, successful per-role byte proofs, 12 new held-out C/CZD pairs, original sign/rank/order effects and Holm10 confirmation. Reject an empty phase, stopped pilot, missing direct authorization or unqualified series.
order_generation: Python random.Random(order_seed) Fisher-Yates shuffle of six P-first pairs followed by six ZD-first pairs, before new package timing.
primary: Use the original numeric direct 2x effect, rank/order/sign gates for the 12 new paired P/ZD observations. Freeze evidence for the qualifying original ten-comparison combined decision at entry, report it separately and show an eleven-test Holm sensitivity, with both original failed packages permanently p=1. Slots not run for lack of data receive p=1. No pooling.
raw_A_policy: Independently warm two newly owned, previously unedited P and ZD histories from the immutable original tool-only donor. Each arm must have exactly matching complete raw inventories, rosters and program/list behavior on its ordinary and traced final A repeats. Before running any ZD warmup seal all 17 allowable A program raw hashes using this new P A control alone. For cross-arm A and all B observations retain actual raw and require exact matching path/list/argv/size and either identical raw SHA or the single source-proven 0/8 reciprocal Wild alternatives, byte-exact elsewhere. Keep the two reference phases distinct.
raw_B_policy: Run a new unscored P+B admission first. Before the first ZD+B or any scored command, freeze all 17 P raw control hashes and their only eligible complete alternate on B, or just the input raw hash if geometry is ineligible. Identical later raw pairs also have to be in the finite control class. Require raw SHA, unchanged remainder, direct emitted ELF sections, valid independently recomputed reciprocal ELF images/IDs, and preserve original observed per-arm file values. No numerical observation selects a form. The fresh P/ZD replication has no pilot; all its scored subjects and restores are new.
resources: 122 GiB strict floor separately on root and scratch, 26 GiB total executable tmpfs budget incl other prior banks, 20 GiB RAM + 6 GiB tmpfs headroom, one writable complete normal target at any time. Before entry prove charged capacity from actual allocations. Preserve every historical bank and all previously measured results; no borrowing writable inodes.

rodata_scope.distinct_output_reporting: Keep both raw image hashes and contents, true widths, note values and proof for each distinct pair. These are visible on-disk differences to ELF consumers.
rodata_scope.format: Final x86-64 ELF64 little-endian ET_DYN PIE. One SHT_PROGBITS .rodata with exact sh_flags 0x32 (ALLOC, MERGE, STRINGS), zero link/info and one read-only PT_LOAD. Only its ELF section header sh_entsize may switch between exactly 0 and 8. ELF e_shentsize and all other headers, sections, executable instructions, relocations, symbols, entire padding and file lengths stay byte-identical. The second allowed difference is the 32-byte GNU build-ID payload of the proper 48-byte .note.gnu.build-id output. Recompute both BLAKE3 IDs independently using released Wild semantics; reciprocal whole-file SHA-256 reconstruction and a streamed raw equality check outside the two proven fields are mandatory. Reject every other type, attribute, field, note, changed width, exit, test-list or program version.
rodata_scope.producer: The exact released Wild is identical across P/ZD SDKs. Derive only from this independent P control, under the unchanged Q6 source-verified ELF geometry. Historical C/CZD are preserved and supply no subject hash or timing to the new P/ZD baseline.
rodata_scope.prospective_controls: reject changes to .text, .rodata payload, section/PHDR flags and extents, e_shentsize, unchanged width with modified bytes, changed .note identity/header/ID, section-name confusion, wrong roles, list/CLI differences, tampered raw/size and individually valid two IDs over other changed data.
rodata_scope.roles: all 15 explicitly enumerated Cargo-published test programs and both normal CLI executables, same role and path only

role_comparison: bare released-source P against standalone zeroize + x86 unsigned division leaf. Identical 64 common SDK bytes, one exact rebuilt driver. No #270 math additions.
sample: Two newly independently warmed P/ZD never-B checkpoints from the retained canonical read-only, tool-only P donor. No reuse of any previous package B or A checkpoint. Require fresh P/ZD compiler/assembler QA, separate traced A→B admissions, 12 new complete pairs with independently randomized 6/6 order, no pilot or efficacy stopping. Each B starts from its own independently restored A. Only prespecified whole-pair verified foreign-work replacement (up to two).
scope: Independent P/ZD full-package replication after a qualified C/CZD package-v3 result on its own twelve held-out pairs. No direct pilot, original C/CZD package v1 and v2 excluded with p=1.
